name: web-swoosh-crop-hero-of-payment-tap-scene
title: Smiling barista holding a tap-to-pay phone and a card, cropped by a giant white swoosh
whatItIs: A café photo of a woman with curly hair presenting a phone showing $25.80 and a hand offering a pale blue card, masked by a huge white swoosh curve that sweeps from top left to bottom right, with a white logo pill at the top right.
whatItMeans: Warm and effortless; the swoosh carves the photo into a soft window.
techniques: Mask a photo with a big white swoosh.
Hold product and UI together in the moment.
Place a pill logo in a corner.
Keep the colour palette to blue and warm café tones.
bestFor: Photo heroes with a graphic mask

vocabulary.definition: A large curve cropping a photo.
Blurred lights in a cafe background.
